title: veronica connata subsp. typica
intro: Veronica connata subsp. typica, commonly known as Blue Pincushion, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae. This plant is known for its blue flowers and is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to treat digestive issues and anxiety due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Veronica connata subsp. typica include its antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory effects, which may aid in reducing muscle spasms and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, such as veronicoside, which have been shown to have antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
